name: Date & Time Tools
description: Fast and accurate date, time, and calendar calculators.
seoDescription: Calculate exact days between dates, add or subtract business days, determine chronological age, and count down to milestone events with verified calendar math.
intro: Calendar math involves unexpected complexities like variable month lengths, leap year adjustments, and weekend business day exclusions. Our Date & Time tools eliminate the guesswork by calculating exact durations, chronological milestones, and project timelines directly in your browser.

howToChoose.title: To measure the gap between two dates
howToChoose.description: Use the Date Difference Calculator to view total calendar days, elapsed months, and working business days (Monday through Friday).

howToChoose.title: To find a past or future date
howToChoose.description: Use the Add or Subtract Days Calculator to shift forward or backward by calendar days or business days.

howToChoose.title: To track an upcoming event
howToChoose.description: Use the Days Until Date Calculator for real-time countdowns to birthdays, holidays, or deadlines.

howToChoose.title: To verify personal milestones
howToChoose.description: Use the Age Calculator to break down chronological age into years, months, days, and total lived hours.

faqs.question: Do these calculators account for leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes. All our date calculators use standard astronomical calendar algorithms that account for 366-day leap years, February 29th boundaries, and century rules.

faqs.question: How are business days calculated?
faqs.answer: Business day calculations automatically exclude Saturdays and Sundays. Holidays can be accounted for by subtracting statutory dates from the total working day result.

faqs.question: Are my birthdates or dates saved?
faqs.answer: No. All date calculations run purely client-side in your web browser. We never log or store any date inputs.

name: Math & Percentage Tools
description: Free percentage, discount, grade, GPA, and unit conversion calculators.
seoTitle: Free Math, Grade & Percentage Calculators | ToolsBuilt
seoDescription: Compute percentages, discounts, course grades, 4.0 scale GPAs, and physical unit conversions instantly with verified formulas and transparent rounding.
intro: Everyday math, academic scoring, and metric conversions require rapid, verified arithmetic. Whether calculating shopping discounts, solving multi-mode percentages, tracking weighted course grades, projecting cumulative GPAs, or converting measurement units, our tools provide clear, instant answers with step-by-step formulas.

howToChoose.title: To solve direct, proportion, or reverse percentages
howToChoose.description: Use the Percentage Calculator to find X% of Y, determine what percentage X is of Y, increase or decrease by X%, or recover the original base value.

howToChoose.title: To measure relative growth or decrease
howToChoose.description: Use the Percentage Change Calculator to determine the relative percentage difference between an initial baseline and a final value.

howToChoose.title: To evaluate sales markdowns
howToChoose.description: Use the Discount Calculator to compute final prices with single or stacked discounts and optional sales tax.

howToChoose.title: To calculate course grades and target exam scores
howToChoose.description: Use the Grade Calculator to compute current weighted course grades and determine the exact score needed on your final exam to hit your target grade.

howToChoose.title: To compute semester and cumulative GPAs
howToChoose.description: Use the GPA Calculator for high school and university GPAs on a 4.0 scale with plus/minus toggles, credit weighting, and multi-semester tracking.

howToChoose.title: To convert measurements between metric and imperial
howToChoose.description: Use the Unit Converter for instant two-way conversions across length, weight, temperature, area, volume, and speed with exact conversion factors.

faqs.question: How are fractional numbers and decimals rounded?
faqs.answer: Financial and standard numerical outputs use half-up arithmetic rounding to sensible precision (2 decimals for currency and percentages, up to 6 decimals for unit conversions), preventing floating-point rounding anomalies.

faqs.question: Can I calculate stacked discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Discount Calculator supports stacked discounts (such as 20% off plus an additional 10% loyalty discount) applied sequentially rather than additively.

faqs.question: How does the GPA calculator handle plus and minus grades?
faqs.answer: The GPA calculator includes an optional plus/minus toggle. When enabled, it applies standard university weights (e.g., A = 4.0, A- = 3.7, B+ = 3.3). When disabled, standard whole letter grades (A = 4.0, B = 3.0, C = 2.0, D = 1.0, F = 0.0) are used.

faqs.question: What reference standards are used for unit conversions?
faqs.answer: All conversion factors adhere strictly to NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology) and BIPM SI standards, using exact international definitions such as 1 inch = 0.0254 meters and 1 pound = 0.45359237 kilograms.

faqs.question: Are my academic grades, financial inputs, or calculations saved?
faqs.answer: No. All calculations run client-side in your local browser environment. We never store, transmit, or log any user input or grade data.

seoDescription: Analyze word counts, character counts, and reading times, or transform text into uppercase, lowercase, title case, camelCase, and snake_case.
intro: Writing and editing for modern platforms demands precise length limits and consistent formatting conventions. Our text utilities help writers, students, and developers analyze document metrics and format case styles effortlessly.

howToChoose.title: To inspect text metrics
howToChoose.description: Use the Word & Character Counter to audit words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading time.

howToChoose.title: To reformat capitalization
howToChoose.description: Use the Text Case Converter to quickly toggle between Title Case, Sentence case, UPPERCASE, lowercase, camelCase, snake_case, or kebab-case.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded or stored?
faqs.answer: No. Text is analyzed and transformed entirely in memory on your device. We cannot view, log, or transmit any drafted text.

faqs.question: How is reading time estimated?
faqs.answer: Estimated reading time is computed using the standard benchmark of 200 words per minute for adult silent reading.

faqs.question: Does the word counter support international text?
faqs.answer: Yes, word boundaries are recognized across multilingual text, symbols, and accented characters.

name: Security & Privacy Tools
description: Client-side password generators and security tools.
seoDescription: Generate strong, cryptographically secure passwords locally on your device with customizable character sets and zero server storage.
intro: Online account protection begins with unique, unpredictable passwords. Our security tools generate strong credentials locally in your browser using modern cryptographic standards, keeping your data entirely in your own hands.

howToChoose.title: To create resilient credentials
howToChoose.description: Use the Strong Password Generator with custom lengths (up to 64 characters), character set toggles, and ambiguous character exclusions.

faqs.question: How are passwords generated securely?
faqs.answer: We utilize the Web Cryptography API (crypto.getRandomValues) rather than pseudo-random functions, ensuring true hardware-backed entropy.

faqs.question: Are generated passwords saved on your servers?
faqs.answer: Never. Generation runs entirely client-side. The moment you close the tab, the generated string is erased from memory.

faqs.question: What is the recommended password length?
faqs.answer: Cybersecurity best practices recommend a minimum of 16 characters combining uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols for high entropy.

faqs.question: Is the random selection truly unbiased?

faqs.question: Can I remove winners after each draw?

faqs.question: How many names can I enter?
